_doc: Aether Sigil progression rules: levels and XP, evolution, fusion. ONE table; every number is tunable and documented.

Data support (bible): level_cap per monster (30-50) and evolution_family (200 families of 5 consecutive ids, FAM-001..200). The bible has NO evolution thresholds, materials, fusion recipes or per-level growth; those are defined here.

Concept sheets: monster-compendium.png shows Sproutstag Lv1 -> Leafstaga Lv16 -> Fangstaga Lv36 (3 forms); meta-screens-symbol-squad-fusion.png shows Luxine -> Luxineon Lv20 -> Auralux Lv40 -> Celestilux Lv60 and Sylpha + Terron -> Verdalux. Lv60 is above every level_cap (max 50), so the compendium's 16/36 thresholds are used. None of those sheet names except Fangstaga exist in the data.

xp._doc: XP per battle for each squad monster that was summoned: (participation + per_ko x its knockouts) x (win_mult or loss_mult) x (1 + tower_bonus_pct/100 x (tower - 1)), rounded. XP to go from level L to L+1 = to_next_base + to_next_per_level x L. Levels stop at the monster's level_cap. Tuned 2026-10-21 with tests/tune_curve.gd: the first values (to_next 20 + 10 x L, +10% XP per tower) levelled the squad to ~Lv45 by T12 and won 93-97% of stages whatever the enemy curve; a near-flat level cost makes levels track ~4 per tower.

growth_pct_per_level._doc: Stat at level L = base x (1 + pct/100 x (L - 1)) x evolution multiplier, rounded. The bible's stats are the level-1 stats. Move and range never grow.

evolution._doc: A monster at or above thresholds[stage] may evolve into the NEXT member of its evolution_family (by id order). The data's families mix elements and roles (0 of 200 share one element_family), so a line keeps its own element, element_family, role, ability and base stats; the family supplies the evolved form's name (and id). Each evolution multiplies hp/attack/defense by stat_mult and raises the skill tier by 1. 2 evolutions max = 3 forms per line, as on the compendium sheet; a monster that is the last member of its family cannot evolve further. Fused monsters do not evolve.

skill_upgrade._doc: Per skill tier: offensive multipliers x (1 + mult_bonus); heal +heal_pct_bonus % of max HP; guard damage-taken multiplier - guard_mult_cut (floor 0.2); cooldown - cooldown_cut (min 1).

evolution.dialogue_doc: Placeholder line for the bible's 'evolution' dialogue type, which has no lines in the data.

fusion._doc: Two owned monsters (both consumed) make one new monster. Deterministic: the parents are ordered primary/secondary by (higher level, then higher rarity, then lower uid), so A+B == B+A. Primary gives element, element_family, role and the Skill ability; the secondary's family becomes a secondary affinity (x secondary_affinity_mult when the secondary family beats the defender and the primary does not) and its ability is inherited as secondary_ability (shown; no battle effect yet). Base stats = weight_primary x primary + (1 - weight_primary) x secondary of the parents' level-1 base stats (after evolution multipliers), x (1 + bonus_pct/100); move and range use the same blend, rounded. Level = the primary's level, XP 0, level_cap = max of the parents. Rarity = max(parents) + rarity_step tiers, capped at the last tier. A recipe overrides name, element and bonus for a specific pair of base monsters.
fusion.name_doc: Generated name = the primary name's first head_len letters + the secondary name from its midpoint, capitalised. If it is taken (any of the 1,000 bible names, an earlier fusion, a recipe result) or a reserved franchise name, the next head length is tried (head_len+1 .. head_len+3), then the tail starts one letter later, then the suffixes in fallback_suffixes are appended.

recipes._doc: The concept sheet's Sylpha + Terron -> Verdalux, rebuilt on monsters that exist: a Wood scout and an Earth support from the starter collection.
